close_reason: Design-validated: review confirmed the existing shape is correct. No code change required. Closing to reduce backlog noise; the docstring + test coverage already document the invariant.
description: src/blob.rs:300-316 — download_blob enforces max_download_body BOTH via Content-Length pre-check AND via per-chunk streaming accumulation. A naive 'just call resp.bytes().await and check len' would buffer the entire response before the check could fire — meaning a hostile server could OOM the client with a single GET. The current implementation correctly streams and rejects mid-flight. Defend this against any 'simplify to .bytes().await' suggestion. Same pattern is documented as 'settled' in AGENTS.md design constraints.
title: Streaming download cap with per-chunk check is the correct shape
